Hi all, I recently worked on two open questions from OEIS A051903 that are already formalized in FormalConjectures/OEIS/51903.lean, and I’m looking for a reviewer.

I found resolutions for both:
conjecture2: False
conjecture3: True

For conjecture3, an explicit witness is

n = 7 x 631 x 881 x 3511^2x 201961 = 9687963167864344937

The PR marking both statements as solved is here:

https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/pull/6759

Thomas Ordowski, who originally posed the questions in the OEIS entry, has also confirmed by email that he is happy with the work/update.

I’d really appreciate it if someone could take a look at the PR and review it. Thanks in advance!

(Also, I pressed Update Branch, which restarted all of my checks after all of them passed....)
